body.label: Target
body.html: One eligible creature within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. This attack may ricochet from one visible solid surface. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense from cover or an intervening obstacle.
Interact with one unattended object along the shot's path.

rider.title: TRICKSHOT
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, you may ignore one intervening creature or obstacle when tracing this shot.
